texture.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one seamless production UI surface texture for the LOCKED Creature Chronicles Forge B3 slate-and-gold game screen. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: sample the almost-black midnight blue-slate interior of its equipment and tooltip panels, NOT the visible text, frames, art, character or scene. Generate a square flat straight-on uniform dark midnight navy-blue slate surface, extremely subtle fine matte mineral grain and restrained soft painterly variation. Overall near #0c1a26 to #142938. Very low contrast; readable ivory UI text and vibrant gear illustrations will overlay it. Seamless/tileable in both directions: match edge colors, no vignette or central highlight. No metallic edge, no border, no ornament, no symbols, no letters, no words, no numbers, no scratches, no logos, no icon, no figure, no equipment, no lighting hotspot. This is exclusively the quiet dark material background. Opaque full canvas. Premium smooth anime fantasy RPG UI material, no photographic surface detail or obvious patterned shapes.
texture.method: Built-in image_gen; opaque PNG master. Pixel-preserving WebP encode quality92/method6, no creative raster edits.
texture.use: Optional low-opacity slate texture under dark overlay; no font/item data baked into art.

vectors.method: Original editable code-native SVG shapes, frames, state variants and approved silhouette interpretation; not raster crops.
